results.description:
I Am Sober is more than just a free sobriety counter app.

Along with tracking your sober days, it helps you build new habits and provides ongoing motivation by connecting you to a wide network of people all striving for the same goal: staying sober one day at a time.

Through our growing sober community you can learn from others and contribute by sharing insights and tactics that have worked for you.

**The I Am Sober app features:**

• Sober day tracker
To visualize how long you’ve been sober.

• Remember why you quit
Add reasons and photos to help you remember why you want to quit your addiction and stay sober.

• Daily pledge tracker
Take a pledge every day. Sobriety is a 24-hour struggle, so start your day off by making a pledge to stay sober. Then you can review how your day went and log notes at the end of the day.

• Sobriety calculator
View how much money & time you’ve saved by being sober.

• Analyze triggers
Recap each day and find patterns that made your day easier or more challenging than the last.

• Share your story
Either with others or for yourself, take photos and journal your progress directly in the app. Then choose to share it or save it as a reminder for yourself.

• Milestone tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond. Compare experiences with others on their sober journey. Read how they felt at this milestone and what you can expect. If you’re struggling, share your story and invite others to offer help or advice.

• Withdrawal timeline
When you create an account and declare your addiction, you can instantly see a withdrawal timeline to get an idea of what to expect for your next few days (and weeks). What’s more, you can contribute to it. See how many others saw an increase in their restfulness vs those that saw an increase in anxiety. Prepare yourself for what’s to come in recovery.

• Customize your experience
You set the time, your sober birthday, the category of motivation you need, the addictions you’re trying to break, even the end-of-day summaries. Make the app customized to your lifestyle and tailored to your needs.

**Sober Plus subscriptions**

I Am Sober is free to use, but you can support development of the app with a subscription to Sober Plus. With Sober Plus, you'll get access to these premium features:

• Create a group
Stay accountable together and track your sobriety privately. Groups are great for complimenting your real-world group like Alcoholics Anonymous, NA, SA, SMART Recovery, or your rehab center.

• Locked access
Keep your trackers private with a lock that you can access via TouchID or FaceID.

• Data Backups
Save your progress in the cloud and restore your trackers if you get a new device.

• More tracking
Track more addictions and get access to more communities. Even if your addiction is specific like Wine, Online Shopping, or Skin Picking, you’ll find a variety of communities of people who are all trying to get sober from alcohol, drugs, eating disorders, self-harm, and more.

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. I Am Sober Plus automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. results.description:
Smartphone addiction, also known as "Nomophobia" - fear of being without a phone, occurs when you experience negative consequences as a result of smartphone overuse. Smartphone addiction can encompass a variety of different use cases, from social media to games to web surfing. 

Smartphone addiction is more prominent than laptop / desktop addiction because smartphones are always with us and can easily gratify our compulsions at any time. We can be come addicted to a cycle of dopamine until it interferes with other parts of our life or causes negative side effects such as stress, depression, anxiety, loneliness, attention challenges, and sleep disturbances. 

Smartphone addiction is not necessarily just the amount of time you spend on your phone or how often you check your phone. Smartphone addiction occurs when your phone usage causes you to experience negative consequences in other parts of your life such as your relationships, school, work, or hobbies. 

Smartphone addiction can often be treated through self-help measures, cognitive behavioral therapy, or group support. 

Disclaimer: This is NOT a diagnostic test. Please consult a mental health professional if you are worried about your smartphone usage. 

Kwon, M., Kim, D. J., Cho, H., & Yang, S. (2013). The smartphone addiction scale: development and validation of a short version for adolescents. PloS one, 8(12), e83558.

results.description:
"I had to force myself to quit playing Triple Town in order to write this review, which might give you some idea of just how addicting it is." - Gamezebo.com 5 star review.

* Featured FOUR TIMES by Apple in "New and Noteworthy"!
* Runner up, indie game of 2011 - Edge Magazine 
* Runner up, social game of 2011 - Gamasutra.com 

Triple Town is an original puzzle game in which you try to grow the greatest possible city. The larger the city you build, the more points you score. You build your city by matching three or more game-pieces: combine three grasses to make a bush, three bushes to make a tree... until you've filled the board with houses, cathedrals and castles. Along the way, you'll have to outwit giant bears who will try to block your progress. 

How large can you grow your dream city before the board fills and the game ends? 

Triple Town is free to play forever. Eventually, you will run out of moves, but they replenish for free if you wait a while, and you can also buy more moves with free coins that you earn in-game. If you want to eliminate the move counter altogether, there is a one-time fee for *lifetime* unlimited moves. It works on any compatible iOS device you own -- just load the game's option menu on your other devices and select "restore unlimited turns" to activate your purchase on additional devices. (Update: we've added a 2-minute mode that you can play free, forever, as much as you want, by watching advertisements in between play sessions. Or you can pay for unlimited turns, which disables the ads in this mode!)

Do you find yourself falling into the digital vortex in the morning? What started as a snooze of your phone's alarm clock led to hours scrolling?

Are you on your phone before bed, swiping endlessly, only to realize you should be fast asleep? Have you found your child in their room on a screen, well after bedtime?

You aren’t alone. Billions of smartphone users around the globe are dealing with the same issue, addicted to the very devices that "enrich our lives."  

Things such as quality sleep, morning mood, or sustained energy and focus at work or school all have seemingly become more challenging. 

One common stressor that could play a role? Screen Time. 

Mobile phones and tablets and the addictive apps they power are stealing our time and attention, disrupting our daily cycles, sleep, and lives. Phone and screen time overuse and addiction have seemingly become the norm. 

But does it have to be this way? Do we have to accept this way of digital life? 

**********

NoPhone - Digital Detox
Stay screen free when and where it matters most.

**********

Purpose:
- Micro-doses of digital detox to improve mental health
- Help break phone and screen addiction
- Detox from tech when it's most important
- Encourages you to set down your iPhone at key times and places

Key Benefits:
- Improve sleep & overall wellness
- Boost mood & ability for focus
- Reinvigorate relationships
- Detox from digital distractions

Key Use Cases:
- *Sessions*: On-demand digital detox breaks
- **Routines**: Planned times to go screen-free

*NoPhone Sessions*:
- Time-based digital detox sessions
- Launch NoPhone app, start a session, and lock your phone
- A timer will appear on your lock screen, encouraging you to stay off! 
- How long can you go? View your report card after each session to see your interruptions and "screen-free score"

**NoPhone Routines**:
- Personalized NoPhone sessions to fit into your lifestyle at specific times
- Example Routines: NoPhone at Morning: Prevent doomscrolling in bed when you first wake up; NoPhone at Night: Stop scrolling after bedtime
- Custom Routines: Add unlimited routines for activities you want to make phone-free (ex: Dinner, Coffee, Meditation, etc)
- Custom Reminders: Schedule notifications or alarms to start your routines at specific times of the day/week

Session/Routine Features:
- Siri: Use Siri to quickly start NoPhone
- Pickup Alerts: Warnings when you unlock your phone during a session or routine
- Widgets: Start NoPhone directly from the home screen
- Live Activities: View NoPhone timer and details directly from the lock screen

**********

Other App Features:

Detox Trends:
- Access session highlights and insights about your screen-free time, interruptions, and more
- See daily, last 7 days, and last 30 day averages to track your improvement

Strict Mode:
- Automatically end a NoPhone session when a device is picked up / unlocked

Family Sharing: 
- Purchase a family license, and share access to NoPhone on eligible devices
- Benefit from significant savings versus individual subscriptions for each family member

iCloud Sync:
- Securely sync with iCloud and save preferences, routines, and sessions across all your Apple mobile devices
- Restore NoPhone routines and preferences on a new device

**********

results.description:
PhoneLess helps you reduce screen time, break the pull of distracting apps, and build a healthier relationship with your phone. It gives you different ways to change your habits, helps you understand what works for you, and connects you with people trying to do the same.

Your phone isn't the enemy. But sometimes a quick check turns into 30 minutes of scrolling, an app gets downloaded again, or a screen-time limit gets dismissed without thinking.

Instead of expecting one solution to work for everyone, PhoneLess gives you different ways to take back control — from app blocking and physical barriers to challenges, accountability and tools to understand your habits.

BLOCK DISTRACTING APPS

Choose the apps and websites that take more of your time than you'd like and block them using Apple Screen Time permissions. Create focused periods for work, study, sleep or simply being away from your phone.

Block or limit:
• Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and Snapchat
• YouTube, Netflix and entertainment apps
• Reddit and other scrolling-heavy apps
• Games, dating and shopping apps
• News and distracting websites
• Adult content and pornography
• Or any other apps you choose

MAKE IT HARDER TO GIVE IN

PhoneLess lets you create stronger commitments around the apps you want to use less. And when you want a physical barrier, there's Poff.

GO PHYSICAL WITH POFF

Poff is an optional NFC blocker that takes app blocking outside your phone. Choose your apps, tap your iPhone to Poff, and they stay blocked until you physically return and tap Poff again.

Unlocking becomes a conscious decision instead of another button you tap without thinking.

DON'T DO IT ALONE

Changing your relationship with your phone doesn't have to be a solo thing. Create groups with friends, see each other's progress, take on challenges together and add accountability when willpower isn't enough.

Connect with a community of people trying to reclaim their time, share progress and learn from people working toward the same thing.

LEARN WHAT ACTUALLY WORKS FOR YOU

PhoneLess isn't just about making your Screen Time number go down. We want you to understand your relationship with your phone.

Explore different approaches to digital wellbeing, learn about the thinking and research behind them, try them yourself, and see what helps you change. PhoneLess helps you discover what works for you and build habits that last beyond the app.

MAKE CHANGE SOMETHING YOU WANT TO KEEP DOING

Reducing screen time doesn't have to feel like punishment. Take on challenges based on your screen-time progress, build streaks, complete quests, earn rewards and customize Doomi as you improve.

Track your screen time, Doom apps and focus habits so you can actually see your progress.

USE PHONELESS FOR THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER

• Reduce social media and doomscrolling
• Focus while working or studying
• Protect your sleep from late-night scrolling
• Be more present with friends and family
• Create healthier digital boundaries
• Take a digital detox without relying only on willpower
• Spend more time on the things you care about

MORE THAN AN APP BLOCKER

PhoneLess isn't about getting rid of your phone. Phones are incredibly useful. It's about making sure you're the one deciding how you spend your time.

Block when you need a barrier. Get accountability when you need support. Try challenges when you need motivation. Learn what works for you. Use Poff when you want the decision to become physical.

Some features require iOS Screen Time permissions. PhoneLess Pro unlocks additional features including advanced history, customization, challenge modes and group upgrades. Poff is an optional physical product sold separately where available.

Less life in here. More life out there.

You may have heard that watching porn with a partner can ignite a more satisfying sex life, but countless hours of scientific research would suggest otherwise. Even light exposure to pornography can cause both men and women to become less interested in their partners looks and sexual performance.
 
2. Being addicted to porn may cause erectile dysfunction
 
Erectile dysfunction was nearly unheard of in men under 35 before the days of internet porn. Now, with the easy accessibility of internet porn, men may experience erectile dysfunction in their teens, twenties, and beyond. Studies have shown that this is caused by a combination of lowered pleasure chemicals in the brain as well as the users propensity to consume porn alone, in front of a screen, which makes it difficult to be aroused by a real life partner.

Just like with drugs, alcohol, or cigarettes, when someone consumes porn, their brain is flooded with a feel good chemical known as dopamine. After viewing porn consistently, a person's brain is inundated with dopamine, and the brain responds by shutting down dopamine receptors. With fewer receptors, the brain cannot respond to dopamine in the same way.
 
4. Porn fuels sex trafficking
 
There are plenty of young women who enter the porn industry by their own free will, but many of the performers in porn are victims of human trafficking, ofter recruited by the use of violence or threats

The more porn a person consumes, the more likely they are to associate pleasure with a fake fantasy. This makes it harder to become aroused by a real person, or be interested in a relationship. This causes porn users to become alienated from their partners, and puts people at risk for psychological problems.
 
6. Porn addiction destroys your body image
 
Because of the fact that most performers in porn are touched up with makeup, cosmetic surgery, or photoshop, porn users are regularly exposed to unrealistic expectations of the human body. This causes porn users to become more likely to feel badly about the way that they look.
 
7. Porn addiction can cause psychological problems

You know that feeling. Headphones on, lying in the grass, just you and your music with no distractions. Those ten minutes on the bus with the snake game on your T9 keypad. Blocky photos you took with your first digicam. That is 1bit.

We think the early 2000s got something right. Not just nostalgia. A clear head. No algorithm waiting when you only meant to check the time. No doomscrolling. We don't block apps, we just give you a more fun one. You keep your banking app and your transit pass, all available when you need them. Get the dumb phone experience without buying a second phone that you will put down as soon as you get tired of its limitations.

This is the digital detox you never have to quit.

WHAT IT IS

A gloriously retro phone experience in two colors. Black and white, one grid, every shade a dither pattern on a screen that never pretends to be anything else. Put the launcher widget on your home screen and each row opens into a quiet world with nothing in it pulling you back.

WHAT IS INSIDE

• Music. Add files or play from your library. Gapless, a real peak meter, an optional tactile wheel like your favorite mp3 player had.
• Podcasts. Search, subscribe, queue, download, sleep timer. Stream them or download them.
• Web. Addiction-proof browsing. One page at a time, no tabs. Block ads and scripts. 1bit images or none at all. No videos at all.
• News. Old school RSS reader. Only the feeds you picked, in publish order, plus a read-later shelf.
• Camera. A 1-bit viewfinder that develops into black and white film when you save to your camera roll.
• Maps. A drawn map, search, saved pins, route guidance. No frills.
• Phone and text. Classic dial pad. Your contacts, favorites, and a record of every call you made from here.
• Calendar and reminders. Your real calendars and lists.
• Notes and voice memos. Plain text in a folder over USB.
• Clock. Alarms, timer, stopwatch with Live Activities.
• Games. Solitaire, minesweeper, snake on a drawn keypad, brick breaker on the wheel.
• Widgets. Launcher, clock, today, and a great big shortcut button to any feature you use the most.

Switch any section off in settings. It stays off.

WHY IT FEELS DIFFERENT

Nothing here makes up reasons to pull you back. No algorithms trying to learn who you are. No notifications to tickle your dopamine. News ends. Music stops when the album ends. The browser will not autoplay video at you. Alerts stay off until you turn them on.

Pick a retro font. Pick a size. Day, night, or following the sun.

SETTING UP

The guide is in the app. Pop our widgets on the home screen, tuck everything else away, black wallpaper, grayscale with a triple-click to bring color back. Ten minutes.

YOUR DATA

We don't like having our data harvested so we don't collect yours. No account. No server. No analytics. No third-party SDK. Sync uses your own iCloud if you want it.

WHAT YOU NEED

An iPhone running iOS 18 or later.

THE PRICE

Free for fourteen days, everything unlocked. Then one purchase, once. No subscription. Nothing else to buy.

"How did it get to 2 AM when I was just browsing for a bit..."

WillStone is an app designed to help you gradually reduce phone usage. Instead of implementing strict daily screen time limits like other digital wellbeing apps, we've designed a unique time exchange system:

Entertainment apps have limited usage time, but you can earn more screen time through focused activities and positive apps (such as learning, exercising, walking, meditation, building habits, early bedtime, etc.).

We help you put down your phone progressively while building healthy habits!

【Design Philosophy】
- Immediate satisfaction drives motivation: A 1898 study by Thorndike showed that behaviors followed by satisfying consequences tend to be repeated, while those leading to unpleasant outcomes are less likely to recur. James Clear's "Atomic Habits" also mentions the four-step habit model—cue, craving, response, and reward.
- Cold turkey approaches are hard to maintain: We've tried many screen control apps like Opal, ClearSpace and Apple Screen Time. Often, these get uninstalled after 3 days—just like quitting any addictive substance, going cold turkey rarely works.
- The key to painlessly building good habits is: balancing desires with personal growth.

【How It Works】
- First, set up two categories of apps:
  - Apps you want to limit, such as Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, shopping apps, etc. We'll call these "entertainment apps."
  - Apps that help you grow, like reading apps, Duolingo, vocabulary builders, etc. After setup, grant WillStone screen time access permissions to begin.
- Initially, you get 10 minutes daily for entertainment apps: Once you exceed this, a full-screen notification appears with no "remind me later" option.
- Want more entertainment time? Use positive apps to earn additional screen time. Read books, learn vocabulary, and you can continue browsing. You can also earn time by walking or exercising.

【Use Cases】
We offer multiple ways to earn time:
- Focus Mode: For exam prep, vacation study, evening reading/drawing—use our offline timer. During focus sessions, only selected apps remain accessible, helping you concentrate. Earn entertainment time as a reward.
- Reading, Vocabulary, Language Learning: Add learning apps to your positive apps list—we'll automatically track usage and reward proportional entertainment time.
- Early Bedtime: WillStone reminds you when it's bedtime and locks entertainment apps. Maintaining healthy sleep patterns earns bonus entertainment minutes the next day, encouraging your brain to embrace better sleep habits.
- Exercise and Walking: WillStone automatically tracks your activity duration (via Apple Health) and rewards entertainment time proportionally. Meditation counts too!
- Daily Habits: Whether it's drinking water, post-work shower, neck exercises, or rehabilitation—customize your habits with reminders and goals. Complete daily tasks to earn entertainment time, making healthy lifestyle changes effortless.

【Features】
- Exchange System: Convert positive app usage, early bedtime, habits, exercise, meditation, walking into entertainment app time
- Custom Exchange Rates: Adjust difficulty levels and conversion ratios for gradual progress
- Widgets: Display available time and quick-start focus timer on home screen
- Analytics: Track your time balance and app usage distribution in "Performance" and "Data" sections

Have other habits you'd like to build? Contact us and let us know!

Monkeyless is a mindfulness screen time app that helps you end phone addiction by meditating before opening distracting apps.

The average person spends over 6 hours a day on their phone. What about you?
The root cause? Low mindfulness.

It’s so easy to open Instagram or TikTok and, hours later, realize you’ve lost track of time. Hours have passed by.
Your mind is on autopilot. East Asian philosophy describes this as the "Monkey Mind" - restless and mindlessly jumping from one thing to another. 
Like every addiction, breaking the habit seems like fighting uphill against yourself. And harsh measures such as blocking apps, or setting time limits never seem to work in the long run.

Monkeyless takes a radically different approach. Why?

1. The root cause of doomscrolling is the restless "Monkey Mind," shaped by years of conditioning toward constant distractions such as your phone.
2. The only solution lies in calming this same mind with mindfulness. Simply blocking apps or setting time limits, like most screen time apps do, don't address the root issue.
3. Cultivate mindfulness with meditation. Combine pragmatism with optimism. You don't have to be a monk to do this - but hey, we always welcome you to join us. 

Science?
Using mindfulness backed by science, we make it easier to break these habits in a lasting way. Meditation has been proven to effectively help in dismantling addictive behaviors. 
For instance, a study on Mindfulness-Based Relapse Prevention (MBRP) found that mindfulness training was associated with a reduction in relapse rates among individuals, and it could help manage stress-induced addictive behaviour​. Other research on MBRP and similar approaches has shown reductions in relapse, emotional distress, and impulses.

Ancient wisdom from thousands of years ago is still highly relevant today. 
Change with Monkeyless, break free from the Monkey Mind forever.

RecoverMe is a mobile application to help those who suffer with a gambling addiction. This app was designed with the help of psychologists, psychiatrists and those others suffering from gambling addiction.

RecoverMe is
·     Accessible
·     Discrete
·     Flexible
·     Evidence-based
·     Made with our users
Our novel app uses a large variety of techniques to help manage your urges. This way you can find what works best for you and take back control of your life. Join the RecoverMe community and escape from the clutches of gambling addiction, football betting and casino games. In combination with gambling blocking software, RecoverMe can help you to stop gambling and manage your urges. RecoverMe works around you and you are free to go through the programme at your own pace.

Features of RecoverMe
·     CBT: There are six easy to follow cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) sessions to empower you to overcome a gambling addiction.
·     Diary: This will improve your self-awareness and allow you to monitor your progress through this journey.
·     Mindfulness: These audio sessions have been developed to encourage you to focus on the present moment. Mindfulness with CBT has been shown to be effective in beating a gambling addiction.
·     Support: We help find a way for you to connect with others embarking on a similar journey or other organisations that may be helpful.
·     SOS: This unique section will provide you with strategies to better manage your urges to gamble when you experience them in real-time.

RecoverMe is not and should not be used as a medical device or in place of professional medical advice. The app helps guide you and is to be used as a tool for self-reflection. All information on our app and website has been created as an educational resource and should not be used as a substitute for proper and personalised professional medical advice or be used to make decisions about your health. We recommend that you seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this before making any medical decisions.

Gambling addiction calendar helps you realize when you are addicted to gambling, and helps you stay accountable for when you let yourself be tempted by the idea of gambling. Use gambling addiction calendar to stop gambling and lower your risk of losing money that you can’t afford to pay back, or family member that love you.
 
Join the no gambling movement and stop gambling addiction! People who have used this app have seen a great increase in self-control and patience. Just take one day at a time and look forward to the new you without being addicted to gambling. Not only will this app help you stop gambling, but it will help you take your life back. 
 
Features:
1. Use our counter to track your progress down to the second.
2. Track how much money and time you have saved since you quit gambling.
3. Create your own reasons to quit gambling, or use one of our scientifically based facts about quitting.

Here are our top 6 reasons to stop being addicted to gambling:
 
1. Gambling is addictive
 
No matter who thinks they have full control of themselves, gambling has been known to take hold and pull people away from their life savings. When you win for the first time, you get a rush of endorphins, and you will be chasing that feeling forever. Acknowledge that this can happen, and cut all ties with gambling.
 
2. Gambling addiction can make you avoid your life and responsibilities
 
You may lose interest in your job and start to drift away into day dreams of hitting it big with your next jackpot. Before you know it, performance might slip at work and you could be fired, or even quit your job looking for the next big hit!
 
3. Gambling will not make you rich
 
I am sure that you have heard stories of someone hitting the multi-million dollar jackpot, but the odds of that happening are slim. Most gambling addicts will simply waste away their money until they have nothing left. Gambling is not a sustainable lifestyle.
 
4. Gambling is stressful
 
Be honest with yourself. You’re not always going to be winning when gambling. In fact, you will be doing a lot more losing than winning. When you are losing, you are stressing. You are losing money, and putting detrimental physical stress upon yourself.
 
5. Gambling addiction will change your mood and you may become rude
 
People who are addicted to gambling can bend their own morals for the benefit of their addiction. Lashing out at people is not uncommon, especially when you think about how much money you are losing. Don’t let the addiction take hold of your personality
 
6. Addiction to gambling destroys your drive
 
Since most gambling is based off of blind luck, addicts will get the illusion that they don’t have to work for money. This will instill a negative cycle of thinking that any day now you will hit it rich. For most gambling addicts, this doesn’t happen.
 
Download this free app now to start yourself well on your way to quitting gambling!
